description: This file contains functions and types related to generating warnings for missing default account configurations in chat channels, including handling of account bindings and default account settings.

methods.name: normalizeBindingChannelKey
methods.description: Normalizes a raw channel key string, trimming and converting to lowercase if necessary.

methods.name: collectChannelsMissingDefaultAccount
methods.description: Collects channels that are missing a default account, returning their context including normalized account IDs.

methods.name: collectMissingDefaultAccountBindingWarnings
methods.description: Generates warnings for channels missing default account bindings, considering existing bindings and coverage.

methods.name: collectMissingExplicitDefaultAccountWarnings
methods.description: Generates warnings when multiple accounts are configured but no explicit default is set, or when the default does not match configured accounts.
